name: Coffee Pub Scribe
tagline: Turn journal passages into chat cards, handouts and printable exports.
description: Converts a blockquote in a journal entry into a styled chat card, a player-viewable handout or an image posted to chat, and exports pages or whole journals to HTML for print or PDF.
pitch: Turn journal passages into styled chat cards, handouts and shareable images in one click, so you can narrate a scene without leaving your notes.

features.title: Narration chat cards
features.text: A GM-only toolbar on a journal blockquote posts the passage to chat with one Narration click.

features.title: Scene formatting
features.text: Headings become card titles, images get captions, and Heading 6 becomes dialogue with the speaker highlighted.

features.title: Instant handouts
features.text: Copy a passage into a player-viewable journal entry in a chosen folder and post a link to chat.

features.title: Share images
features.text: Post single images from a passage to chat, where players can view them full size.

features.title: Export and print
features.text: Export pages as HTML, or open a whole journal in a browser tab to print or save as PDF.

steps: Open a journal page, click Edit, and put the text in a blockquote using the quote button.
Click Narration on the toolbar along the bottom of the block to post it to chat as a card.

gallery.caption: Scribe
gallery.title: Read-aloud text, ready for chat
gallery.text: The toolbar under a journal passage posts it to chat as a narration card with its heading and image. Players get the card and a viewable illustration, while GM-only notes stay in the journal.
